title: Hodge classes on powers of split Weil sixfolds
exact_target: Suppose a complex abelian sixfold A has an imaginary-quadratic-field action and a compatible polarization whose rational Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature (3,3). Does every rational Hodge class on $A^m$ come from a rational algebraic cycle, for every positive m and every codimension?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Suppose a complex abelian sixfold A has an imaginary-quadratic-field action and a compatible polarization whose rational Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature (3,3). Does every rational Hodge class on $A^m$ come from a rational algebraic cycle, for every positive m and every codimension?

\subsection{Short English statement}
Suppose a complex abelian sixfold A has an imaginary-quadratic-field action and a compatible polarization whose rational Hermitian form is hyperbolic of signature (3,3). Does every rational Hodge class on $A^m$ come from a rational algebraic cycle, for every positive m and every codimension?
